snippet.title: People of Note | Under the Lights Trailer
snippet.description:
People of Note is coming to PC and consoles in 2026!

Cadence is played by two actors: Heather Gonzalez alongside the pop-star vocals of @LEXXE 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1626170/People_of_Note/ 
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014972/ 
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/people-of-note/9NB2TF2P011B 
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/people-of-note-e50325 
Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/people-of-note-switch-2/

About People of Note:
In this turn-based RPG musical, join Cadence as she recruits an ensemble of musicians on her quest for stardom. Experience turn-based combat like never before, where each battle is a musical performance with evolving combat conditions and genre-bending mashup attacks!
